source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: Declare Battle Formations lets you place your ASURYANI MOUNTED and VYPER units in Reserves, and later in the battle each of them may arrive using the Strategic Reserves arrival rules. Each time you set up one of your ASURYANI MOUNTED or VYPER units on the battlefield, count the battle round as one higher than it really is. Also, when your opponent’s turn ends, you may lift some of your ASURYANI MOUNTED or VYPER units off the battlefield into Strategic Reserves, skipping any unit within Engagement Range of an enemy unit: up to 1 unit at Incursion, 2 at Strike Force or 3 at Onslaught.

battleRoundForSetup.appliesTo: every setup of a friendly ASURYANI MOUNTED or VYPER unit on the battlefield
